achievements.name: First Duel
achievements.description: You stepped into the arena. The crowd holds its breath.

achievements.name: Arena Regular
achievements.description: Five battles fought. You're no longer just a visitor.

achievements.name: Seasoned Duelist
achievements.description: Twenty battles. You know the smell of the arena well.

achievements.name: Veteran of the Void
achievements.description: Fifty battles contested. Win or lose, you always return.

achievements.name: Centurion of Clashes
achievements.description: A hundred battles. The arena was built for someone like you.

achievements.name: Battle-Hardened
achievements.description: Two hundred duels. Scars don't slow you down anymore.

achievements.name: The Relentless
achievements.description: Five hundred battles. Your opponents see your name and hesitate.

achievements.name: Legend of the Arena
achievements.description: A thousand battles. They'll be telling stories about you long after.

achievements.name: First Conquest
achievements.description: You bested another mind. The taste of victory is yours.

achievements.name: Five-Time Victor
achievements.description: Five opponents outwitted. You're developing a reputation.

achievements.name: Dominant Force
achievements.description: Twenty wins. Opponents are starting to study your patterns.

achievements.name: Champion of Fifty
achievements.description: Fifty battles won. The arena whispers your name.

achievements.name: Uncrowned King
achievements.description: A hundred victories. The crown fits whether they give it or not.

achievements.name: The Untouchable
achievements.description: Two hundred wins. Your opponents already know how this ends.

achievements.name: Apex Predator
achievements.description: Five hundred duels claimed. You hunt secrets for sport.

achievements.name: The Unconquerable
achievements.description: A thousand battles won. There is no opponent left who doesn't fear you.

achievements.name: First Dawn
achievements.description: You answered the call on day one. The ritual has begun.

achievements.name: Five Days Strong
achievements.description: Five daily challenges conquered. This is becoming a habit.

achievements.name: Three-Week Warrior
achievements.description: Twenty daily challenges. You show up even when it's hard.

achievements.name: Golden Fifty
achievements.description: Fifty daily completions. A fixture of the daily leaderboard.

achievements.name: The Centurion's Call
achievements.description: A hundred daily challenges done. Rain, shine, or mystery — you're here.

achievements.name: The Devoted
achievements.description: Two hundred daily challenges. What even is a rest day?

achievements.name: Half-Millennium Daily
achievements.description: Five hundred daily challenges. This has become your daily bread.

achievements.name: The Faithful
achievements.description: A thousand daily challenges. Your loyalty is inscribed in the ledger.

achievements.name: Daily Deity
achievements.description: Five thousand daily challenges. The game bends to your schedule now.

achievements.name: First Whisper
achievements.description: You breathed your first question into the void. The game has begun.

achievements.name: Curious Cat
achievements.description: Ten questions down. You're getting warmer.

achievements.name: Fifty Shades of Maybe
achievements.description: Fifty guesses deep. You've tasted yes, no, and everything between.

achievements.name: Centurion of Questions
achievements.description: A hundred guesses asked. Your instincts are sharpening.

achievements.name: The Half-Millennial
achievements.description: Five hundred questions. The sphinx would fear you by now.

achievements.name: The Grand Inquisitor
achievements.description: A thousand guesses. You have made the art of asking your own.

achievements.name: Five Thousand Whispers
achievements.description: Five thousand questions. The universe has few secrets left from you.

achievements.name: Decamillennial Doubter
achievements.description: Ten thousand guesses. You've questioned everything — twice.

achievements.name: Oracle's Shadow
achievements.description: Fifty thousand questions. You walk the line between seeker and sage.

achievements.name: The All-Questioner
achievements.description: One hundred thousand guesses. You are the question itself.

achievements.name: Back-to-Back
achievements.description: Two days running. The flame flickers to life.

achievements.name: Week Warrior
achievements.description: Seven consecutive days. A full week of showing up.

achievements.name: Fortnight of Fire
achievements.description: Fourteen days straight. Two weeks of unbroken devotion.

achievements.name: Monthly Master
achievements.description: Thirty consecutive days. A full month of daily dedication.

achievements.name: Quarterly Legend
achievements.description: Ninety straight days. An entire quarter of unwavering resolve.

achievements.name: Half-Year Hero
achievements.description: One hundred eighty days without pause. Six months of devotion.

achievements.name: Year-Round Champion
achievements.description: 365 consecutive days. An entire year without missing a beat.

achievements.name: Biennial Titan
achievements.description: Two full years, day after day. There are no words — only reverence.

achievements.name: First Blood
achievements.description: You named the nameless. The secret never saw you coming.

achievements.name: Five-Star Detective
achievements.description: Five victories. Your instincts are beginning to sharpen.

achievements.name: Pattern Weaver
achievements.description: Twenty wins. You don't just guess — you deduce.

achievements.name: Mind Unlocker
achievements.description: Fifty secrets cracked. Lesser minds would have stopped long ago.

achievements.name: The Centurion
achievements.description: A hundred wins. One hundred times the secret has bowed to you.

achievements.name: Double Century
achievements.description: Two hundred victories. Your reputation precedes you.

achievements.name: Vault Cracker
achievements.description: Five hundred mysteries solved. No secret is safe in your presence.

achievements.name: The Revealer
achievements.description: A thousand identities unmasked. You are the answer they dreaded.

achievements.name: The Omniscient
achievements.description: Five thousand wins. You have become the thing you sought.
